title: Relief Allowed Against a Ridgecrest Advantage Closing Settlement
content:
Credit adjustments standing on the premium account of a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment are allowed against the closing settlement as follows.

| Where the account and the cadence show | The relief allowed against the settlement |
| --- | --- |
| The enrollment is billed quarterly and at least 2 credit adjustments stand on the premium account | Every credit adjustment posted on the account in the contract year, whatever reason each of them carries |
| At least 1 credit adjustment stands on the premium account, and either fewer than 2 of them stand on it or the enrollment is billed monthly | The credit adjustments posted on the account in the last 3 months, whatever reason each of them carries |
| No credit adjustment stands on the premium account | Nothing |

The reason recorded with a credit adjustment never changes whether it is allowed: a credit granted for a retroactive rate change, for a duplicate payment, for a billing error or for a low income premium subsidy is allowed on the same footing as any other.

*A premium account on an enrollment billed quarterly carrying exactly 1 credit adjustment.* The first row is not reached, because fewer than 2 credit adjustments stand there; the second row governs, and the relief allowed is the credit adjustments posted in the last 3 months.

*A premium account on an enrollment billed quarterly carrying 3 credit adjustments, of which 1 falls inside the last 3 months.* The first row governs, and the relief allowed is all 3 of them, so far as each was posted in the contract year.

*A premium account carrying no credit adjustment at all.* The relief allowed against the settlement is nothing, on either cadence.
